notes.title: Speedrunner's Update!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! Thanks so much for the great reception to Glowkeeper! Here's a quick week 1 update to the game :)

In light of people already trying to speedrun Glowkeeper, we've just launched a [url="https://www.speedrun.com/glowkeeper"]speedrun.com page[/url]! 

If you haven't had enough of Glowkeeper, maybe try finding the best route to speedrun Glowkeeper? I tried it myself and it's a pretty tough and interesting puzzle in its own right
[/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed certain visual artifacts in the first area[/p][/*][*][p]Patched a small bug where gates don't open when you undo into the room[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the Debug Console[/p][/*][*][p]Added Speedrunner's Mode[/p][/*][*][p](The above 2 can be toggled in settings.cfg in the game files)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Glowkeeper Release Date
notes.content:
[p]Mark your calendar! Glowkeeper will be releasing on the 29th of August, in less than four weeks!

Get ready to delve deep into the luminescent world of Glowkeeper[/p][list][*][p]Seven (or eight?) distinct areas, each featuring new mechanics and interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Over 90 puzzles to solve, with 40 scrolls to collect[/p][/*][*][p]Secrets and meta-puzzles :)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Demo Retirement[/h3][p]
On release date, we'll be taking down the demo from Steam. 
[/p][p]As for why, in it's current state, the demo's save file won't transfer over at all to the full game. Also, part of the joy of Glowkeeper is returning to earlier areas with new knowledge, and I fear the demo would spoil a number of mechanics that would diminish the experience of the full game. 

An archive of it will still be left of in [url="https://oolimry.itch.io/glowkeeper"]itch.io[/url], for those who want to try it, especially if you want to check if your computer is able to support it.[/p]
